data.long_meaning: The name Boarer is derived from the Old English word 'borer', meaning a plowman or one who tills the soil. This name carries the symbolism of strength, endurance, and hard work. The name Boarer carries the meaning “Strong Plowman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Boarer usually hope their child will grow to embody strong plowman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
